reason: My doctor said my magnesium might be low, but I can grab a bottle of magnesium at the drugstore for way less than $25 and I already have my Toplux that I reorder. Thirty foil sachets a month feels like a lot of trash for something I can take from a bottle.
objection: $24.99 to $29.99 a month is a lot on my budget when a plain bottle of magnesium costs a fraction of that, and the sachets are just extra packaging waste.
would_change_my_mind: A price near $15 a month, or my doctor telling me this exact form is the one I need.
